causes.38143844052: Terminal job input was intentionally purged but read_job decoded empty input instead of returning AlreadySubmitted; fixed in c32c23b.
causes.38144172373: Successful intermediate source; superseded by cancellation, account credential guard and storage/queue boundary fixes. Not final acceptance.
causes.38145573110: Cancelled obsolete source after the queue capacity fixture was found to reuse one deduplicated source instead of filling the queue.
causes.38145601605: Cancelled obsolete source after formatting the distinct-source queue fixture; no final acceptance.
causes.38145623478: Successful intermediate source before newly recognized credential deletion correction and native adapter Memory guard tests. Not final acceptance.
causes.38145861185: Memory tests passed on all platforms; Windows failed unchanged Host two_clients_replay_detach_live_events_and_snapshot_have_one_committed_watermark at service.rs:129 with Elapsed timeout (20/21 service tests passed). Exact source run 38145623478 passed this Host test; root cause not established, no timeout or assertion weakened. Final source still requires its own exact full CI.

limits: Historical failed/cancelled/intermediate results do not establish final I-4.1 acceptance.
